panels.title: 00 - 核心驾驶舱 / Trading Operations Cockpit
交易入口状态 / Trading Runtime State
panels.description: 日常盯盘第一判断：Broker ready、登录、行情 WebSocket、Gateway reachable。

panels.title: 监控池与订阅 / Universe and Subscriptions
panels.description: 这里展示数量，不是利用率：pool 是行情监控池，trade watchlist 是交易扫描池，context ws 是固定上下文订阅。

panels.title: 行情新鲜度 / Market Data Freshness
panels.description: 行情消息与 5m bar pipeline 的延迟。regular session 默认 60s/180s 关注。

panels.title: 信号与订单健康 / Signal and Order Health
panels.description: 信号循环、订单失败和严重 IB 错误的核心摘要。

panels.title: 账户资金核心 / Account Capital Core
panels.description: 账户净清算值与剩余购买力；只取真实 account snapshot/summary 来源。

panels.title: 账户风控状态 / Account Guard Core
panels.description: 账户快照、买力 guard 和 account data circuit 的核心状态。

panels.title: 服务采集在线 / Service Scrape Health
panels.description: Prometheus 能否抓到 IBKR 与监控组件。

panels.title: 主机核心资源 / Host Core Resource
panels.description: CPU、内存和关键文件系统剩余百分比。

panels.title: 01 - 核心趋势 / Core Trends
账户资金核心趋势 / Account Capital Core Trend
panels.description: 净清算值、购买力、可用资金与现金趋势；refId 唯一，避免 Grafana No data。

panels.title: 行情新鲜度趋势 / Market Data Freshness Trend
订阅 Active vs Limit / Subscription Active vs Limit
panels.description: 订阅槽位明细。context ws 是 SPY/QQQ/VIX 等固定上下文行情，不代表完整监控池。

panels.title: 错误趋势 / Error Trend
02 - 服务健康详细 / Service Health Details
抓取目标在线 / Scrape Targets Up
IBKR 服务在线 / IBKR Services Up
监控组件在线 / Monitoring Services Up
Systemd 单元状态 / Systemd Unit State
03 - Gateway、登录与 WebSocket / Gateway Session and WebSocket
Gateway 核心状态 / Gateway Core State
Gateway Socket 监听 / Gateway Socket Listening

targets.expr: max by (service, environment, host, port) (ibkr_gateway_socket_listening{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: Gateway 状态与 Uptime / Gateway Status and Uptime
Broker 连接尝试 QPS / Broker Connect Attempts

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, result, reason_code) (rate(ibkr_broker_connect_attempts_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Broker 断连与 IB 错误 / Broker Disconnects and IB Errors

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, ib_error_code, severity) (rate(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Gateway Socket Probe p95 / Gateway Socket Probe p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, source, result) (rate(ibkr_gateway_socket_probe_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Gateway 最近探测失败 / Gateway Recent Probe Failures

targets.expr: sum by (source, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_gateway_socket_probe_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", result!="ok"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 04 - 行情订阅与数据新鲜度 / Market Data Subscriptions and Freshness
监控池数量 / Universe Symbol Counts
panels.description: 把监控池、交易扫描池、固定上下文订阅与当前 active 订阅分开展示，避免把 context ws 误读为 monitor。

panels.title: 订阅数量 / Subscription Counts
panels.description: context ws 是固定上下文行情订阅；完整监控池看左侧 Universe。

panels.title: 订阅利用率 / Subscription Utilization
panels.description: 容量利用率只看 total/trade/websocket；不再把 context ws 的 3/3 显示成 monitor 100%。

panels.title: WebSocket 消息年龄 / WebSocket Message Age
5m Bar Lag / 5m Bar Lag
Bar Pending Symbols / Bar Pending Symbols
05 - 账户资金与购买力风控 / Account Capital and Buying Power Guard
账户资金 / Account Capital
保证金与持仓占用 / Margin and Exposure
购买力阈值 / Buying Power Floors
账户风控状态 / Account Guard State
账户资金趋势 / Account Capital Trend
保证金与敞口趋势 / Margin and Exposure Trend
06 - 信号、反向与订单链路 / Signals Reverse and Orders
信号阶段 QPS / Signal Stage QPS
panels.description: 主图只保留 stage/result，source/reason 明细放到表格，避免图例遮挡。

panels.title: 信号阶段 p95 延迟 / Signal Stage p95 Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, stage, result) (rate(ibkr_signal_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 信号结果明细 / Signal Result Details

targets.expr: sum by (stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_signal_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 订单/反向结果个数 / Order and Reverse Counts

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__range]))
sum by (stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_signal_events_total{stage=~"reverse_.*", service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 订单事件 QPS / Order Event QPS
订单操作 p95 延迟 / Order Operation p95 Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_order_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 订单命令个数 / Order Command Counts

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"place_bracket|place_entry|place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_order|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|modify|cancel|tracker_update|tracker_poll|tracker_live_orders_fetch|execution_fill|pb_order_sync"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 保护单 TP/SL 与调整个数 / TP SL Modify Counts

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|modify|cancel|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|pb_order_sync", order_family_type=~"entry|take_profit|stop_loss|bracket_oco|partial_harvest_bracket|unknown|mixed"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 07 - Broker 请求压力 / Broker Request Pressure
IB API 请求 QPS / IB API Request QPS

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, request_kind, result) (rate(ibkr_broker_request_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: IB API 请求 p95 延迟 / IB API Request p95 Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, request_kind) (rate(ibkr_broker_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: IB API Pending 请求 / IB API Pending Requests

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, request_kind) (ibkr_broker_pending_requests{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: IB 错误码统计 / IB Error Codes
08 - 历史数据与回补 / History and Backfill
历史事件 QPS / History Event QPS

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, source, interval, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_history_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 历史操作 p95 延迟 / History p95 Operation Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, source, interval, operation) (rate(ibkr_history_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 历史活跃请求 / History Active Requests
历史行数吞吐 / History Rows Throughput

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, source, interval, operation) (rate(ibkr_history_rows_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 09 - HTTP 入口与出站依赖 / HTTP and Dependencies
入口 QPS / Inbound Request QPS
入口 p95 延迟 / Inbound p95 Latency
出站 QPS / Outbound Request QPS
出站 p95 延迟 / Outbound p95 Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, target_service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 入口/出站处理中请求 / In-Flight Requests
HTTP 异常与错误 / HTTP Exceptions and Errors
10 - 主机与进程资源 / Host and Process Resource
CPU 使用率 / CPU Usage
内存使用率 / Memory Usage
文件系统剩余 / Filesystem Free
待执行/积压请求 / Pending and Backlog

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, request_kind) (ibkr_broker_pending_requests{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: 11 - 影响规模与报警辅助 / Impact Counts and Alert Context
最近 5m 入口请求/错误个数 / Inbound 5m Counts
最近 5m Broker/订单错误个数 / Broker and Order 5m Counts

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, ib_error_code, severity) (increase(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[5m]))
sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", result!="ok"}[5m]))

title: 量化监控 - 分阶段请求链路 / Quant Monitoring - Phased Request Flow
